ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The table in the figure is the “Statistical Table of the Age and Sex of the In-migrant Population,” listing age groups of 0～14 years old, 15～29 years old, 30～44 years old, 45～59 years old, and ≥60 years old, and listing male population and female population by sex, with the unit being ten thousand persons. In the table, the 15～29-year-old in-migrant population is the largest, with 25.14 ten thousand males and 37.10 ten thousand females; 30～44 years old is also relatively large, with 14.68 ten thousand males and 11.63 ten thousand females; 45～59 years old are respectively 4.94 ten thousand males and 4.01 ten thousand females. The in-migration of a large amount of population in this age group will increase this city’s labor supply and number of job seekers. If the growth of jobs is insufficient, it will make employment competition greater, so it may intensify the local employment tension situation.

raw_record.question_text:
The following table is the “Statistical Table of the Age and Sex of the In-migrant Population of a Certain City in Shandong Province” at the time of China’s sixth population census.

<image1>

According to the information in the table, what impact may the in-migrant population have on employment in this city?
raw_record.standard_answer: It has intensified the local employment tension situation

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：表格列出山东省某市迁入人口按年龄段和性别的数量，15～59岁各年龄段迁入人口占主要部分，特别是15～29岁数量最大。再结合题干询问“对就业的影响”，把15～59岁视为主要劳动年龄人口，判断大量劳动年龄人口迁入会使该市求职人数增加、劳动力供给扩大，从而推得可能加剧当地就业紧张局面。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中表格为“迁入人口年龄及性别统计表”，按年龄段列出0～14岁、15～29岁、30～44岁、45～59岁、≥60岁，按性别列出男性人口和女性人口，单位为万人。表中15～29岁迁入人口最多，男性25.14万人、女性37.10万人；30～44岁也较多，男性14.68万人、女性11.63万人；45～59岁分别为男性4.94万人、女性4.01万人。总体看，15～59岁劳动年龄段人口占迁入人口的主要部分。再推理：15～59岁通常是主要劳动年龄人口，大量该年龄段人口迁入会增加该市劳动力供给和求职人数，如果就业岗位增长不足，就会使就业竞争加大，因此可能加剧当地就业紧张局面。
method.model_answer: 加剧了当地就业紧张局面
